 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Madrid had a blockbuster summer transfer window, making a number of signings to strengthen the squad at Jose Mourinho's disposal.
 The biggest of those signings, undoubtedly, was Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Ivorian winger has already shown glimpses of his enormous potential. After a slow start to life in the Spanish capital, he has come into his own in recent weeks .
 Diomande opens up about his Real Madrid dream
 Playing for Los Blancos means much more than just football for the 19-year-old. Speaking in an interview, Diomande explained how this transfer was the fulfilment of a lifelong ambition.
 "Real Madrid is the transfer I've dreamed of since I was a child, and it's hard to find the words to describe what it means to have achieved it," Diomande admitted (h/t Madrid Zone ).
 The 19-year-old's journey to this point has been extraordinary. He received his first major opportunity with Leganes in 2025.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Impressive performances for the La Liga club earned him a move to RB Leipzig, where he went on to have a breakthrough season.
 Yan Diomande has repeatedly shown his willingness to track back and defend. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images)
 One campaign was enough to convince Real Madrid that he was worth spending around €140 million on.
 Diomande expressed gratitude to both his former clubs for the roles they played in helping him become the player he is.
 He also admitted that despite achieving his childhood dream, he still misses his friends and family back home.
 Real Madrid seem to have struck gold
 It is still early days, but the feeling is that Real Madrid have landed a major coup by signing Yan Diomande.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In just a few months, he has already made the team look better when he plays on the left wing than when Vinicius Jr. does.
 How does Diomande's role change with the return of Vinicius Jr? (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images)
 One aspect of his game that Jose Mourinho will be a huge fan of is his innate willingness to track back and defend.
 The Ivorian winger has also started chipping in consistently with goals and assists and looks set to have an important role to play throughout the season.
 The one concern right now is how the 19-year-old's prominence changes once Vinicius returns from suspension.
 It remains to be seen whether Mourinho switches Diomande back to the right wing or uses him in rotation with Vinicius in the important games ahead.
